Treat Injury (DC 16; Requires Medical Kit): The character treats the Paralytic Poison.

system.description:
See also: Poisons, Hazards

An injected Poison renders a target immobile for a short time.

Paralytic Poison Statistics (CL 5)

Keywords: Artificial, Contact, Poison

Trigger: A creature is injected with the Paralytic Poison.

Attack: +10 vs Fortitude Defense

Recurrence: Each round at the start of the target's turn, until the Paralytic Poison is treated.

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Treat Injury (DC 16; Requires Medical Kit): The character treats the Paralytic Poison.

Special: A creature moved to the bottom of the Condition Track by Paralytic Poison is Immobilized but does not fall unconscious.
